text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Shall we be on our way, then?

To head out on their Dubai expedition,
the group of four led by Victoire Pisa
boarded an international flight.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: This is Dubai...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Look at all these amazing objects!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I heard the night view is super pretty too.
I'm so excited♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this heat—it's fascinating!
It's all about how many cards you can assemble that suit the environment."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume, everyone!
The lodging hotel is over here~!
This time, it wasn't just myself as the Trainer; several staff members assigned by the URA accompanied us as well.

She knows a lot about Dubai expeditions
and plans to help us with things like arranging
accommodations and training facilities.
Training commenced the following day.

Being able to book lodging together for all four seemed to have paid off;
they appeared relaxed, without any unnecessary tension.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It may be an unfamiliar foreign land, but as long as we stand together in a circle, I'm sure we'll be fine♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Let's make this the greatest race ever...!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Ohh♪
Yes, ma'am.
Heh, but of course!
Just at that very moment...
Suddenly, "it" struck Japan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...The scale of this is—?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Get down, Flash-senpai!
Everyone, hit the dirt—!!

An unprecedented great earthquake
that swallowed everything in the blink of an eye.

Tremors struck across the country, centered on Eastern Japan—
It was the largest earthquake in the nation's recorded history.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Damage like this...
Is it, really...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(――...I can't.
I shouldn't just stay feeling down.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (I've held back from contacting them, but... maybe it's time to check if everyone is safe—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even though a few days have passed... I hear the aftershocks are still continuing. Is everyone safe?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Tracen Academy is... safe.
Both the school building and the students. However...—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...How much do you understand
about our situation here?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We've been keeping up with the situation in the disaster areas through news broadcasts.
Though not everything, we have a general grasp of it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: As for the rest of the situation in Japan... not really. I did peek at social media the other day, though.

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like it's still shaking." "Aftershocks..."
"I'm scared." "Is this the end of Japan?"
"I want to take a shower." "I hope the disaster area is okay."

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"I went to that concert I've been dying to see today♪"
"Times like these are precisely when we need to find things to enjoy, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"In light of the social situation, we are extending the performance dates."
"Some people won't be able to make it, after all..."
"We want to be as accommodating as possible."

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"Private vehicles, stay out of the disaster area!"
"Relief supplies aren't arriving at all." "Casualties are being transported."
"—Closing my account for a while."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It was a chaotic state overflowing with all sorts of emotions...
There was certainly mutual support, butâ

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The circle once connected through the net... had vanished along with everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Social media isn't the only place where the loop is severed.
...Allow me to explain the situation around me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In the dorms... more girls holed up in their rooms.
Many stopped showing their faces even in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Due to the earthquake, distribution networks were cut off,
and people swarmed supermarkets and convenience stores.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Everything has been completely sold out.
Everyone is desperate to protect themselves.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
............
The situation's getting worse by the day, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: On the train... many stare down at the screens in their hands with somber expressions.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I... just don't have the heart
to blame people like that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now,
every form of entertainment is being canceled or held back.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I was in no state to engage in cheerful, lighthearted chatter.
Even if I tried to face it, I'd first be confronted with my own helplessness.
And any entertainment I fled to was accompanied by lingering guilt.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
When that happens... your heart wears down bit by bit.
For some... they lose the strength to connect with others and face the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Are you all right?
I heard you haven't been showing up to the cafeteria much.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that. I'm okay.
Lately, I've just been... getting tired easily.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...And yet, I haven't been able
to do a single thing for them."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...Forgive me.
I didn't mean to bring up such a topic.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
…………
No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't push yourselves too hard.
Rose-san, and everyone else too...
(...Beep.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...So many things have truly changed, haven't they?
Everything is falling apart."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that whatever we had woven
through racing... had never existed from the start—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ah, aagh... Wh-what's—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean, "hope"...?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To think that something which only functions in gentle, carefree days could be called "hope"—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When I haven't accomplished anything of note—
to think I'd try spreading it to the world...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I let it go to my head...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm sorry.
For bringing up something like this.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me...!

I ran after her as she dashed out of the lodgings...
but she was already nowhere in sight.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*...!
Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... haaah...
...—"

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me... Are you a Japanese horse girl, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay...? Japan's going through a tough time right now, huh?
I just went and donated some money too.

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
May Japan recover and regain its vitality soon—
...Everyone is praying for that.

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
I only wish something would happen to raise the spirits of the Japanese people, if even a little.
...Though I suppose that is mere fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for holding you up.
See you later. It's dangerous, so hurry on home.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Something to cheer me up...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Bigger, even bigger.
'Maysa'—bring 'Hope.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We can ‘weave’ it.
—From ‘HPED’, to ‘HPED’."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Weav... ing... a greater,
even greater... hope..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Is that... the meaning behind those words?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...However.
Still—what should I... do...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(—The hope we wove together has faded away.
If we are to reconnect it once more,
it has to be... now. But—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (A hope to overwrite that despair... If only I could have been in Japan instead of Dubai—)

—I ran through the streets of Dubai, chasing after her.
It's dangerous to wander around alone so late at night.
Urging on my screaming body, I strained my eyes. ...And then.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.
I rush over to her as she stands frozen. It doesn't look like she got caught up in any trouble, but—
Her expression was one of total loss.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To... to me...—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Could we possibly weave hope together?
—I couldn't understand what was being asked of me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps
this is complacency on my part."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To show a ray of hope
in the depths of such deep despair...
is no ordinary feat.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Being in Dubai, there's hardly anything I can do directly for Japan—and yet...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, right now, before my very eyes...
lies the pinnacle of world-class racing.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If I can pull off something here
that no one has ever achieved beforeâ

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even from a tragedy too devastating to recover from, one can bounce back—can't we make them believe that miracles do happen?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Could we perhaps... kindle even a faint light of hope
in the heart of someone who has completely lost strength?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A great hope... A hope strong enough
to endure this extraordinary pain—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to weave it with victory.
I must weave it...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"But could I really—
Could I really run a race like that...?"

Impossible?
No, that's definitely not the case.

A few passersby turned around at the raised voice.
—Not that it mattered.

Victoire Pisa has accomplished it all,
time and time again.

Soothing Rose Kingdom's heart, bringing Eishin Flash into the fold,
and forging the bond among classmates so strong it revolved on its own.

Ignite a frenzy at the Japan Derby,
gain enough strength to stand alongside Buena Vista,
and then, at the Arima Kinen—

Connecting all of Japan together,
and bringing one more Umamusume back to the turf.
choice_data_list: ...Japan might be feeling down right now.

text_block_list.text:
According to Rose Kingdom,
many people's hearts were deeply divided right now.

Even the bond she had woven across all of Japan
had powerlessly unraveled.
Even so, even if that were true—
choice_data_list: If you vow to see it through to the end, you will surely succeed.
If you swear you'll see it through, you can definitely do it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: I'm here to support you in that.
I'm here to support you in that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh!!
(――*snap*)

She slapped both of her cheeks with her hands.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: My eyes... opened.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Do what must be done.
That is why I have run in races all this time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through victory, hope to Japan.
Even if it's small... a definitive light.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will weave it together, without fail...!

Rousing my spirits, I chased after
Victoire Pisa as she strode forward.

"A Japanese Umamusume has seized glory in Dubai."
—Let's deliver that hope back home to Japan.
Together with her, who is gentler and stronger than anyone...!
